comments.body:
It's easy to check requirements.

1. Bring up the Quest Information screen (Q button shortcut, or access it from your discoveries list if it isn't an active quest)
2. Look for and click Quest Information button in the upper right corner
3. Past Quest screen shows previous quests/discoveries in the chain leading up to the current quest

I'm afraid I haven't done this series of quests yet, so I'm ironically unable to do any of that. If somebody wishes to confirm the actual quest chain info and apply updated information if needed, that would be appreciated. Cheers.
